name: mr-video
description: Render a subtitled explainer video of a GitLab MR change, keep the latest one at the top of the MR description, and post each render as an MR comment for history.

interface.shortDescription: Explain an MR with a subtitled video
interface.longDescription: Render a subtitle-only explainer video of the author's GitLab MR change (diagrams, before/after code, comparison tables), upload it, and keep the latest one at the top of the MR description without touching the rest of the text, posting each render (a changes-only video when re-rendering) as an MR comment for history. Windows only.
defaultPrompt: Use $mr-video to render a subtitled explainer video of this GitLab MR and embed it in the MR description.
